source.head: f9de8e2c
source.db: snapshot of db/corpus.sqlite via sqlite3 backup, 2026-09-23

what_moves: Only production and fluency.items change. Every added item is a say_now phrase the learner met in an EARLIER unit (R44, R79a as validate_speaking_path.py checks them), already through speak_filter (register) when it was placed as say_now and again by the production selector; fluency items are zero-new-token against the unit's known set. say_now, shadowing, words, patterns, drills, kanji_recognition and checkpoint are untouched, so input and language-focused counts do not change. Production prompts are the sentence's existing pt-BR translation (Layer B), answer_key/accepted_variants come from build_speaking_practice.variants(); nothing is authored.

builder_rule.change: Replace the flat PRODUCTION_PER_UNIT=3 / FLUENCY_PER_UNIT=6 with per-stage caps (`caps` below). Selection order is unchanged, so the shipped items stay a prefix. Floor rule: in a unit, production grows toward its cap only while the fluency block keeps at least the item count it gets at the shipped caps (3/6); without it arrival-02 loses its fluency block (R79 FAIL). The per-unit production counts that rule yields are `unit_production_caps`.

replay: For each unit: assert precondition equals the unit's current production sentence list and fluency.items (refuse on drift), then set production (existing objects kept, `add_production`/`swap_fluency_to_production` items inserted at `index`), set fluency.items, seconds_target (8 x items), kind/prompt, strand_counts and strands from `after`; then course.json totals from `course_totals.after`. The durable form is the builder_rule; a replay without it is overwritten by the next export.
